comment: One lane for every request kind; the ceremony scales. Gates are statuses no agent can leave; only `lab approve` / `lab reject` / the dashboard move them. Loop budgets park the request in `blocked`.

awaiting_input.label: Waiting for a document
awaiting_input.comment: RD-2: the Planner or the worker named inputs only a person can supply; a message with inputFor clears one, inputs.timeoutDays resumes the stage that asked with the inputs marked missing

fastLane.comment: A size-S request with no open questions skips Scope and Gate 1 when it is read-only and of one of these kinds, or (RD-2) when every write it plans decides to tier A under the entity policy (src/policy.js).

inputs.comment: Days a request waits in awaiting_input before the stage that asked resumes with the inputs marked missing; a recipe's inputTimeoutDays overrides.

concurrency.comment: Runs in progress at once across requests. A request that writes never runs alongside another request on the same business.
